en.t: Roman Emperor Valentinian I learns the Alemanni have crossed the Rhine and invaded Gaul
en.s: Valentinian I (Latin: Valentinianus; 321 – 17 November 375), sometimes known as Valentinian the Great, was Roman emperor from 364 to 375. He is the second-last emperor to govern the empire as a whole, albeit only from February to March of 364, after which he appointed Valens to rule over the Eastern half of the empire, while he remained in control of the West.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安一世得知阿勒曼尼人越过莱茵河入侵高卢
zh.s: 瓦伦提尼安一世（拉丁名：Valentinianus；321年—375年11月17日），有时也称“瓦伦提尼安大帝”，于364年至375年担任罗马皇帝。他是最后几位曾统治整个罗马帝国的皇帝之一，但只在364年2月至3月短暂统治全境；此后，他任命瓦伦斯统治帝国东部，自己则继续掌管西部。

en.s: The Battle of Snovsk was a battle in 1068 near Chernigov. According to the results of the battle, the Cumans who invaded the territory of Kievan Rus' were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 斯诺夫斯克战役于1068年在切尔尼戈夫附近发生。战役结束后，入侵基辅罗斯领土的库曼人被迫撤退。

en.t: Empress Matilda's reign as "Lady of the English" ends as Stephen of Blois regains the title of "King of England"
en.s: Empress Matilda (c. 7 February 1102 – 10 September 1167), also known as Empress Maud or Athelicia, was Holy Roman Empress as the consort of Emperor Henry V from 1110 until 1125, and was subsequently a claimant to the English throne during the civil war known as the Anarchy (1138–1153). Following the death of her father, King Henry I of England, as his only surviving legitimate child and nominated heir, she asserted her right to the English throne.

zh.t: 斯蒂芬恢复英格兰国王称号，玛蒂尔达的“英国女主人”时期结束
zh.s: 玛蒂尔达女皇（约1102年2月7日—1167年9月10日），又称玛蒂尔达或阿瑟莉西亚，1110年至1125年间是神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利五世的皇后，之后在被称为“无政府时期”（1138—1153年）的内战中争夺英格兰王位。父亲亨利一世去世后，作为他唯一在世的婚生子女和指定继承人，她主张自己有权继承英格兰王位。

en.t: Philip II is crowned King of France
en.s: Philip II (21 August 1165 – 14 July 1223), also known as Philip Augustus (French: Philippe Auguste), was King of France from 1180 to 1223. His predecessors had been known as kings of the Franks (Latin: rex Francorum), but from 1190 onward, Philip became the first French monarch to style himself "King of France" (rex Francie).

zh.t: 菲利普二世加冕为法兰西国王
zh.s: 菲利普二世（1165年8月21日—1223年7月14日），又称菲利普·奥古斯都（法语：Philippe Auguste），于1180年至1223年担任法兰西国王。他的前任通常自称“法兰克人之王”（拉丁语：rex Francorum）；从1190年起，菲利普成为首位自称“法兰西国王”（rex Francie）的法国君主。

en.s: The siege of Sinope in 1214 was a successful siege and capture of the city by the Sultanate of Rum under their Sultan, Kaykaus I (r. 1211–1220). Sinope was an important port on the Black Sea coast of Anatolia, at the time held by the Empire of Trebizond, one of the Byzantine Greek successor states formed after the Fourth Crusade.

zh.s: 1214年，罗姆苏丹国在苏丹凯考斯一世（在位：1211–1220年）率领下成功围攻并攻占锡诺普。锡诺普是安纳托利亚黑海沿岸的重要港口，当时由特拉比松帝国控制。特拉比松帝国是第四次十字军东征后建立的拜占庭希腊继承国之一。

en.s: The Battle of Blanquefort or La Male Journade took place on 1 November 1450 during the Hundred Years' war when a French army drew out Anglo-Gascon forces from Bordeaux in the English-controlled Duchy of Gascony. The Anglo-Gascon infantry suffered heavy losses, and the battle resulted in a decisive French victory. The battle was known locally as La Male Journade or in French Mauvaise Journée and marked the beginning of a campaign to drive the English from Gascony.

zh.s: 布朗克福尔战役又称“拉马勒茹尔纳德”，于1450年11月1日爆发，属于百年战争的一部分。法军迫使英格兰控制的加斯科涅公国境内英格兰—加斯科涅联军离开波尔多。英格兰—加斯科涅步兵损失惨重，法军取得决定性胜利。当地人称此战为“拉马勒茹尔纳德”，法语也称“Mauvaise Journée”（糟糕的一天）。这场战斗标志着法军开始一场将英军逐出加斯科涅的战役。

en.s: The All Saints' Flood of 1570 occurred on November 1–2, 1570 in the Spanish Netherlands, and is considered the worst North Sea flood disaster before the 20th century. It flooded the entire coast of the Netherlands and East Frisia. The effects were felt from Calais in Flanders to Jutland and even Norway. Even though the alleged casualty figures were mostly based on rough estimates and should be viewed with skepticism, up to 25,000 deaths can be assumed.

zh.s: 1570年11月1日至2日，西属尼德兰发生万圣节洪水，被认为是20世纪以前北海地区最严重的洪灾。洪水淹没了荷兰和东弗里西亚的整个海岸，影响从佛兰德斯的加来一直延伸到日德兰，甚至到达挪威。据称死亡人数最高可达2.5万，但相关数字大多只是粗略估算，应谨慎看待。

en.s: The Second Spanish Armada also known as the Spanish Armada of 1596 was a naval operation that took place during the Anglo–Spanish War. Another invasion of England or Ireland was attempted in the autumn of 1596 by King Philip II of Spain. In an attempt at revenge for the English sack of Cádiz in 1596, Philip immediately ordered a counter strike in the hope of assisting the Irish rebels in rebellion against the English crown.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第二支西班牙无敌舰队
zh.s: 第二支西班牙无敌舰队也称1596年西班牙无敌舰队，是英西战争期间的一次海军行动。1596年秋，西班牙国王腓力二世再次尝试入侵英格兰或爱尔兰。为报复英国洗劫加的斯，腓力立即下令反击，希望援助反抗英格兰王室的爱尔兰叛军。

en.s: The Battle of Anjar was fought on 1 November 1623 between the army of Fakhr al-Din II and a coalition army led by the governor of Damascus Mustafa Pasha.

zh.s: 1623年11月1日，法赫尔丁二世的军队与大马士革总督穆斯塔法帕夏率领的联军在安贾尔交战。

en.s: The Battle of Aylesbury was an engagement which took place on 1 November 1642, when Royalist forces, under the command of Prince Rupert, fought Aylesbury's Parliamentarian garrison at Holman's Bridge a few miles to the north of Aylesbury. The Parliamentarian forces were victorious, despite being heavily outnumbered.

zh.s: 艾尔斯伯里战役于1642年11月1日爆发。鲁珀特亲王率领的保王党军队在艾尔斯伯里以北数英里处的霍尔曼桥，迎战艾尔斯伯里的议会派守军。议会派兵力远少于对手，但仍取得胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Denbigh Green (1 November 1645) took place during the closing stages of the First English Civil War. Fought just outside the Royalist garrison of Denbigh, it has been described as probably the only action in the North Wales theatre of the war "meriting the description of battle".

zh.s: 丹比格林战役于1645年11月1日爆发，是第一次英国内战末期的一场战斗。战斗地点在保王党驻军据守的丹比格郊外。有人称，在战争期间的北威尔士战区，可能只有这一场战斗“够得上战役之名”。

en.s: The Battle of Prague, which occurred between 25 July and 1 November 1648 was the last action of the Thirty Years' War. General Hans Christoff von Königsmarck, commanding Sweden's flying column, entered the city, which was defended by the Governor Feldmarshall Rudolf von Colloredo, a veteran of the siege of Mantua and of the battle of Lutzen, where he served under Albrecht von Wallenstein. The Swedes captured Prague Castle on the western bank of the Vltava river and attempted to enter the Old Town on the eastern bank of the river, but were repulsed on the Charles Bridge by Colloredo's men.

zh.s: 布拉格战役发生于1648年7月25日至11月1日，是三十年战争的最后一场战斗。汉斯·克里斯托夫·冯·柯尼斯马克将军率领瑞典机动部队进入布拉格。布拉格由鲁道夫·冯·科洛雷多元帅负责防守；他曾参与曼托瓦围城战和吕岑战役，并在吕岑战役中为阿尔布雷希特·冯·瓦伦斯坦麾下效力。瑞典军队攻占伏尔塔瓦河西岸的布拉格城堡，随后试图进入河东岸的老城，但被科洛雷多的部队在查理大桥击退。

en.s: The Battle of Arklow was a minor skirmish that took place at Glascarrig on the coast road near Arklow in County Wicklow on 1 November 1649. It was fought between the army of the Parliamentarians and the combined forces of the Irish Royalists and Confederates during the Irish Confederate Wars.

zh.s: 阿克洛战役是一场小规模交战，于1649年11月1日在威克洛郡阿克洛附近沿海公路的格拉斯卡里格发生。交战双方是爱尔兰议会派军队与爱尔兰保王党和邦联军队，属于爱尔兰邦联战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Oran (1707–1708) was a battle between the Spanish Empire and the Regency of Algiers. It was started by Mustapha Bouchelaghem, the Bey of Mascara. The Algerian victory in the battle led to the city being reconquered by the Algerians for 24 years (1708–1732), before Spanish forces conquered the town in 1732.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1707至1708年的奥兰围城战是西班牙帝国与阿尔及尔摄政辖区之间的一场战役，由马斯卡拉贝伊穆斯塔法·布切拉格姆发起。阿尔及利亚在战役中获胜，并在1708至1732年间重新控制该城；西班牙军队于1732年再次攻占奥兰。

en.t: In Portugal, Lisbon is totally devastated by a massive earthquake and tsunami, killing an estimated 40,000 to 60,000 people
en.s: The 1755 Lisbon earthquake, also known as the Great Lisbon earthquake, hit the Iberian Peninsula and Northwest Africa on the morning of Saturday, 1 November, Feast of All Saints, at around 09:40 local time. In combination with subsequent fires and a tsunami, the earthquake almost completely destroyed Lisbon and adjoining areas.

zh.s: 1755年里斯本地震也称里斯本大地震，于诸圣节当天，即11月1日星期六上午约9时40分袭击伊比利亚半岛和西北非洲。地震及其后的火灾和海啸几乎彻底摧毁了里斯本及周边地区。

en.s: During the Seven Years' War, the Prussian-held town of Kolberg in Brandenburg-Prussian Pomerania (now Kołobrzeg) was besieged by Russian forces three times. The first two sieges, in late 1758 and from 26 August to 18 September 1760, were unsuccessful. A final and successful siege took place from August to December 1761. In the sieges of 1760 and 1761, the Russian forces were supported by Swedish auxiliaries.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 七年战争中的科尔贝格围城战
zh.s: 七年战争期间，俄军三次围攻由普鲁士控制的科尔贝格镇，位于勃兰登堡-普鲁士波美拉尼亚（今波兰科沃布热格）。前两次围城战分别发生在1758年末和1760年8月26日至9月18日，均未成功。最后一次围城战于1761年8月至12月进行，俄军最终获胜。在1760年和1761年的围城战中，瑞典辅助部队也支持了俄军。

en.s: The 1777 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1777, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Governor William Livingston was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1777年11月1日举行州长选举。现任州长威廉·利文斯顿没有对手，在新泽西州议会中连任。

en.s: The 1793 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1793, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Governor of Connecticut Samuel Huntington won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1793年11月1日举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长塞缪尔·亨廷顿没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: The 1798 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1798, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Federalist Governor Richard Howell was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1798年11月1日举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长理查德·豪厄尔没有对手，在新泽西州议会中连任。

en.s: The 1799 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1799, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Governor of Connecticut Jonathan Trumbull Jr. won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1799年11月1日举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长小乔纳森·特朗布尔没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Laswari took place on 1 November 1803 near Laswari village, Alwar. It was part of the Second Anglo-Maratha War. The British under Gerard Lake were anxious to finish the war by neutralizing the last substantial force that the Maratha confederacy possessed, consisting of 12 battalions of regular infantry trained by the adventurer Chevalier Dudrenec. Dudrenec deserted the Marathas and command fell onto Ambaji Ingle, a veteran Maratha officer.

zh.s: 拉斯瓦里战役于1803年11月1日在阿尔瓦尔附近的拉斯瓦里村爆发，是第二次英马拉塔战争的一部分。杰拉德·莱克率领的英军希望尽快结束战争，消灭马拉塔联盟最后一支主力部队。这支部队由冒险家德杜雷内克训练的12个正规步兵营组成。德杜雷内克叛离马拉塔人后，部队改由马拉塔老将安巴吉·英格尔指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Waren-Nossentin on 1 November 1806 saw soldiers of the Kingdom of Prussia led by August Wilhelm von Pletz and Ludwig Yorck von Wartenburg fight a rear guard action against troops of the First French Empire commanded by Marshal Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte. Though forced to give ground, the Prussians successfully kept the French from inflicting serious loss or cutting off any units in this War of the Fourth Coalition action. Waren lies on the northern end of Lake Müritz, about 70 kilometres (43 mi) southeast of Rostock. Nossentin is a small village on the Fleesen See (Fleesen Lake) about 15 kilometres (9 mi) due west of Waren.

zh.s: 1806年11月1日，瓦伦—诺森廷战役爆发。奥古斯特·威廉·冯·普莱茨和路德维希·约克·冯·瓦滕堡率领普鲁士军队，与让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特元帅指挥的法兰西第一帝国军队交战。普鲁士军队虽被迫后撤，但成功阻止法军造成重大损失或切断普军部队。这是第四次反法同盟战争期间的一场后卫战。瓦伦位于米里茨湖以北，距罗斯托克东南约70公里（43英里）；诺森廷是弗莱森湖畔的一个小村庄，位于瓦伦正西约15公里（9英里）。

en.s: The 1811 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1811, in order to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Joseph Bloomfield was unanimously re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1811年11月1日举行州长选举。现任民主共和党州长约瑟夫·布卢姆菲尔德没有对手，在新泽西州议会中全票连任。

en.s: The Battle of Aslanduz took place on 31 October and 1 November 1812 between the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran during the Russo-Persian War (1804-1813). Russian Imperial army, smaller in number, defeated the Persian troops and captured the spoils.

zh.s: 1812年10月31日至11月1日，俄罗斯帝国与卡扎尔伊朗在俄波战争期间爆发阿斯兰杜兹战役。人数较少的俄军击败波斯军队并缴获战利品。

en.s: The Anglo-Nepalese War (1 November 1814 – 4 March 1816), also known as the Gorkha War, was fought between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Nepal. The conflict was caused by territorial disputes and expansionist ambitions on both sides. Nepal had expanded westward and eastward in the late 18th century, bringing it into conflict with British interests in northern India.

zh.s: 英尼战争又称廓尔喀战争，于1814年11月1日至1816年3月4日爆发，交战双方是英国东印度公司和尼泊尔王国。双方的领土争端和扩张意图引发了冲突。18世纪末，尼泊尔向西和向东扩张，与英国在印度北部的利益发生冲突。

en.s: The Congress of Vienna of 1814–1815 was a series of international diplomatic meetings to discuss and agree upon a possible new layout of the European political and constitutional order after the downfall of the French emperor Napoleon Bonaparte. Participants were representatives of all European powers (other than the Ottoman Empire) and other stakeholders. The Congress was chaired by Austrian statesman Klemens von Metternich (Duke Metternich) and was held in Vienna from September 1814 to June 1815.
en.n: Congress of Vienna opens to re-draw the European political map after the defeat of France in the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1814至1815年的维也纳会议由一系列国际外交会议组成，旨在拿破仑下台后讨论并商定欧洲政治和宪政秩序的新格局。与会者包括欧洲各强国（奥斯曼帝国除外）的代表和其他相关方。会议由奥地利政治家克莱门斯·冯·梅特涅（梅特涅公爵）主持，于1814年9月至1815年6月在维也纳举行。
zh.n: 维也纳会议开幕，旨在法国在拿破仑战争中战败后重新划定欧洲政治版图。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: A presidential election was held in Vermont on November 1, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins received 8 votes from electors chosen by the Vermont General Assembly. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举佛蒙特州结果
zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举期间，佛蒙特州于1816年11月1日投票。美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗和纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的民主共和党候选组合，获得由佛蒙特州议会选出的选举人投下的8票。联邦党未能提名候选人。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: A presidential election was held in Connecticut on November 1, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The senior U.S. senator from New York Rufus King, the de facto candidate of the Federalist Party, received nine votes from electors chosen by the Connecticut General Assembly.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举康涅狄格州结果
zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举期间，康涅狄格州于1816年11月1日投票。联邦党事实上的候选人、纽约州资深联邦参议员鲁弗斯·金获得由康涅狄格州议会选出的选举人投下的9票。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania
en.s: A presidential election was held in Pennsylvania on November 1, 1816, as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Caucus ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins defeated the Independent ticket. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举期间，宾夕法尼亚州于1816年11月1日投票。美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗和纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的党团会议候选组合击败独立候选组合。联邦党未能提名候选人。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: A presidential election was held in Ohio on November 1, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: A presidential election was held in Ohio on November 1, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 23 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk. Clay won Ohio by a narrow margin of 1.94%. This was last election where a Whig won Ohio.

en.s: Local government elections took place in London on 1 November 1906. All council seats in all 28 metropolitan boroughs were up for election. en.s: The Walthamstow by-election, 1910 was a parliamentary by-election held in England on 1 November 1910 for the House of Commons constituency of Walthamstow. It was then a division of Essex, but the area is now part of Greater London. This was a ministerial by-election. The laws of the time required that an MP who had joined the government had to seek re-election, and the early stages of the campaign saw controversy about whether the election should be contested. However, the main issue in the election was the Osborne judgment, in which the courts had banned trade unions from imposing a political levy on their members.

en.s: The Battle of Coronel was a First World War Imperial German Naval victory over the Royal Navy on 1 November 1914, off the coast of central Chile near the city of Coronel. The East Asia Squadron (Ostasiengeschwader or Kreuzergeschwader) of the Kaiserliche Marine (Imperial German Navy) led by Vice-Admiral Graf Maximilian von Spee met and defeated the British West Indies Squadron commanded by Rear-Admiral Sir Christopher Cradock. The engagement probably took place as a result of misunderstandings. Neither admiral expected to meet the other in full force. Once the two met, Cradock understood his orders were to fight to the end, despite the odds heavily against him.

zh.s: 1914年11月1日，第一次世界大战期间，德意志帝国海军在智利中部科罗内尔市附近海域击败英国皇家海军。马克西米利安·冯·施佩伯爵海军中将率领德意志帝国海军东亚分舰队（Ostasiengeschwader或Kreuzergeschwader），与克里斯托弗·克拉多克爵士海军少将指挥的英国西印度群岛分舰队交战并取胜。双方可能因误会而相遇，两名海军将领都没想到会碰上对方的主力。克拉多克明白，尽管胜算很低，他仍奉命战斗到底。

en.s: The Second Battle of Agua Prieta, 1 November 1915, was fought between the forces of Pancho Villa and those of the future President of Mexico, Plutarco Elías Calles, a supporter of Venustiano Carranza, at Agua Prieta, Sonora, as part of the Mexican Revolution. Villa's attack on the town was repulsed by Calles. The battle helped to establish Carranza's control over Mexico and directly led to his becoming, with United States recognition, president. Villa believed that Calles had received tactical and strategic support from the United States since the town is located across the border from Douglas, Arizona and launched his raid on Columbus, New Mexico partly as a reprisal.

en.s: The Battle of Empress Augusta Bay, on 1–2 November 1943—also known as the Battle of Gazelle Bay, Operation Cherry Blossom, and in Japanese sources as the Sea Battle off Bougainville Island (ブーゲンビル島沖海戦)—was a naval battle fought near the island of Bougainville in Empress Augusta Bay. The naval battle was a result of Allied landings on nearby Bougainville in the first action in the Bougainville campaign of World War II and may also be seen as part of the Solomons and New Guinea campaigns. The battle was significant as part of a broader Allied strategy—known as Operation Cartwheel—aimed at isolating and surrounding the major Imperial base at Rabaul.

As part of Operation Buster, 6,500 troops were involved in the Operation Desert Rock I, II, and III exercises in conjunction with the tests.
en.n: Operation Buster–Jangle: Six thousand five hundred United States Army soldiers are exposed to 'Desert Rock' atomic explosions for training purposes in Nevada. Participation is not voluntary.

zh.s: “克星—丛林”行动是美国于1951年末在内华达试验场进行的一系列核武器试验，共七次，其中六次为大气层试验，一次为 爆坑试验。它是美国国防部（“克星”行动）与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室（“丛林”行动）首次联合开展的试验计划。作为“克星”行动的一部分，6500名军人参加了“沙漠岩石”第一、第二和第三阶段演习，与这些试验配合进行。
zh.n: “克星—丛林”行动期间，6500名美国陆军士兵在内华达州参加原子弹爆炸训练。“沙漠岩石”演习并非自愿参加。

en.t: Nuclear weapons testing: The United States successfully detonates Ivy Mike, the first thermonuclear device, at the Eniwetok atoll. The explosion had a yield of ten megatons TNT equivalent
en.s: Nuclear weapons tests are experiments carried out to determine the performance of nuclear weapons and the effects of their explosion. Over 2,000 nuclear weapons tests have been carried out since 1945. Nuclear testing is a sensitive political issue. Governments have often performed tests to signal strength. Because of their destruction and fallout, testing has seen opposition by civilians as well as governments, with international bans having been agreed on.

zh.t: 美国在埃内韦塔克环礁成功引爆“常春藤迈克”，首枚热核装置试爆成功，爆炸当量达1000万吨TNT
zh.s: 核武器试验是为测定核武器性能及其爆炸效果而进行的试验。自1945年以来，各国已进行两千多次核武器试验。核试验也是敏感的政治议题：政府常借此展示实力；鉴于试验的破坏性及放射性尘埃，民众和政府都有人反对，国际社会也已达成禁止核试验的协议。

en.t: On 1 November 1952, the Teller–Ulam configuration was tested at full scale in the Mike shot of Operation Ivy, at an island in the Enewetak Atoll, with a yield of (over 450 times more powerful than the bomb dropped on Nagasaki during World War II)
en.s: A thermonuclear weapon, fusion weapon, or hydrogen bomb (H-bomb) is a second-generation nuclear weapon, using nuclear fusion. The most destructive weapons ever created, their yields typically exceed first-generation nuclear weapons by twenty times, with far lower mass and volume requirements. Characteristics of fusion reactions can make possible the use of non-fissile depleted uranium as the weapon's main fuel, thus allowing more efficient use of scarce fissile material.

zh.t: 泰勒—乌拉姆构型于1952年11月1日在“常春藤行动”的“迈克”核试验中进行全尺寸测试，地点为埃内韦塔克环礁一座岛屿，爆炸当量超过二战投向长崎的炸弹450倍
zh.s: 热核武器又称聚变武器或氢弹，是利用核聚变的第二代核武器。它是人类制造过的破坏力最强的武器，爆炸当量通常超过第一代核武器20倍，同时对质量和体积的要求低得多。聚变反应的特性还使武器能够以不可裂变的贫化铀作为主要燃料，从而更高效地利用稀缺的可裂变材料。

en.s: General elections were held in Cuba on 1 November 1954. Fulgencio Batista won the presidential election running under the National Progressive Coalition banner, whilst the main opposition candidate, Ramón Grau San Martín, withdrew his candidacy before election day. Progressive Action Party emerged as the largest party in the House of Representatives, winning 60 of the 130 seats. Voter turnout was 52.4%.

zh.s: 古巴于1954年11月1日举行大选。富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔代表国家进步联盟赢得总统选举。主要反对派候选人拉蒙·格劳·圣马丁在投票日前退出。进步行动党成为众议院最大党，赢得130席中的60席。投票率为52.4%。

en.s: The Algerian War, also known as the Algerian Revolution, the Franco-Algerian War, or the Algerian War of Independence, was an armed conflict between France and the Algerian National Liberation Front (FLN) from 1954 to 1962, which led to Algeria winning its independence from France. An important decolonization war, it was a complex conflict characterized by guerrilla warfare and war crimes. The conflict also became a civil war between the different communities and within the communities. The war took place mainly on the territory of French Algeria, with repercussions in metropolitan France. Effectively started by members of the FLN on 1 November 1954, during the Toussaint Rouge ("Red All Saints' Day"), the conflict led to serious political crises in France, causing the fall of the Fourth Republic (1946–1958), to be replaced by the Fifth Republic with a strengthened presidency.

zh.s: 阿尔及利亚战争又称阿尔及利亚革命、法阿战争或阿尔及利亚独立战争，是法国与阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线（FLN）于1954年至1962年间的武装冲突，最终阿尔及利亚脱离法国独立。这场重要的去殖民化战争十分复杂，既有游击战，也发生了战争罪行；不同社群之间以及社群内部也爆发内战。战事主要发生在法属阿尔及利亚境内，也波及法国本土。冲突实际上始于1954年11月1日诸圣节红日（Toussaint Rouge），由FLN成员发动。战争引发法国严重政治危机，导致第四共和国（1946–1958年）垮台，并由加强总统权力的第五共和国取代。

en.s: United Air Lines Flight 629, registration N37559 and dubbed Mainliner Denver, was a Douglas DC-6B aircraft that was blown up on November 1, 1955, by a dynamite bomb placed in the checked luggage. The explosion occurred over Weld County, Colorado, United States, 8 miles (13 km) east of Longmont, at 7:03 p.m. local time, while the airplane was en route from Denver to Portland, Oregon, and Seattle, Washington.

zh.s: 联合航空629号班机注册号为N37559，绰号“丹佛主线客机”，是一架道格拉斯DC-6B客机。1955年11月1日，有人在托运行李中放置炸药，飞机因此被炸毁。当地时间晚上7时03分，飞机从丹佛飞往俄勒冈州波特兰和华盛顿州西雅图途中，在美国科罗拉多州韦尔德县朗蒙特以东8英里（13公里）处上空爆炸。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 1 November 1956. The Antigua Labour Party retained all eight elected seats and the party's leader Vere Bird became Minister of Trade and Production after a ministerial system of government was established. Voter turnout was 57%.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1956年11月1日举行大选。安提瓜工党保住全部8个民选席位。政府设立部长制后，该党领袖维尔·伯德出任贸易与生产部长。投票率为57%。

en.s: The States Reorganisation Act, 1956 was a major reform of the boundaries of India's states and territories, organising them along linguistic lines. Although additional changes to India's state boundaries have been made since 1956, it remains the most extensive change in state boundaries since the independence of India.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Turkey on November 1, 1957 immediately after the 1957 general elections on October 27. Members of the Grand National Assembly re-elected Celâl Bayar as president. In the same year the 1957 Turkish general election were held.

zh.s: 土耳其于1957年11月1日举行间接总统选举，紧接着10月27日举行的1957年大选。大国民议会议员重新选举杰拉勒·拜亚尔为总统。同年还举行了1957年土耳其大选。

en.t: The Mackinac Bridge, the world's longest suspension bridge between anchorages at the time, opens to traffic connecting Michigan's upper and lower peninsulas
en.s: The Mackinac Bridge ( MAK-ə-naw; also referred to as the Mighty Mac or Big Mac) is a suspension bridge that connects the Upper and Lower peninsulas of the U.S. state of Michigan. It spans the Straits of Mackinac, a body of water connecting Lake Michigan and Lake Huron, two of the Great Lakes.

zh.t: 麦基诺大桥通车，当时是锚碇间跨度最长的悬索桥
zh.s: 麦基诺大桥是一座悬索桥，连接美国密歇根州的上半岛和下半岛，横跨麦基诺海峡。该海峡连接密歇根湖与休伦湖，两者都是五大湖的一部分。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tanganyika on 1 November 1962. They were the first elections following independence the previous year and the decision to form a republic. Julius Nyerere, leader of the ruling Tanganyika African National Union and incumbent Prime Minister won easily with 98.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 坦噶尼喀于1962年11月1日举行总统选举。这是该国前一年独立并决定成立共和国后首次举行总统选举。执政的坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟领袖、现任总理朱利叶斯·尼雷尔轻松获胜，得票率为98.15%。

en.s: On November 1, 1963, President Ngô Đình Diệm and the Personalist Labor Revolutionary Party of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam) were deposed by a group of CIA-backed Army of the Republic of Vietnam officers who disagreed with Diệm's handling of the Buddhist crisis and the North Vietnamese-Viet Cong (VC) threat to South Vietnam. During South Vietnam's later years, some referred to the coup as Cách mạng 1-11-1963 (The 1st November 1963 Revolution).

zh.s: 1963年11月1日，吴廷琰总统和越南共和国（南越）的个人主义劳动革命党被一批越南共和国陆军军官推翻。这些军官得到中央情报局支持，不满吴廷琰处理佛教危机和北越军队、越共对南越威胁的方式。南越后期，一些人将这场政变称为“1963年11月1日革命”（Cách mạng 1-11-1963）。

en.s: The 1964 Australia Cup final was the third Australia Cup Final, the final match of the 1964 Australia Cup. It was played at Olympic Park Stadium in Melbourne, Australia, on 1 November 1964, contested by George Cross and APIA Leichhardt. George Cross won the match 3–2 after extra time, with one goal each from Archie Campbell and two own goals.

zh.s: 1964年澳大利亚杯决赛是该项赛事第3届决赛，也是1964年澳大利亚杯的最后一场比赛。比赛于1964年11月1日在澳大利亚墨尔本的奥林匹克公园体育场举行，由乔治十字队对阵莱卡特意大利人队。乔治十字队在加时赛后以3比2获胜，阿奇·坎贝尔攻入1球，另有两球为对方乌龙球。

en.s: The Chadian Civil War of 1965–1979 (French: Guerre civile tchadienne de 1965–1979) was waged by several rebel factions against two Chadian governments. The initial rebellion erupted in opposition to Chadian President François Tombalbaye, whose regime was marked by authoritarianism, extreme corruption, and favoritism. In 1975 Tombalbaye was murdered by his own army, and a military government headed by Félix Malloum emerged and continued the war against the insurgents.

zh.s: 1965年至1979年的乍得内战由多个反政府派别与乍得的两届政府交战。最初的叛乱是针对总统弗朗索瓦·托姆巴尔巴耶，其政权以专制、严重腐败和任人唯亲著称。1975年，托姆巴尔巴耶被本国军队杀害，费利克斯·马卢姆领导的军政府上台，继续与叛乱者作战。

en.s: Operation Kentucky was a multi-Battalion operation conducted by the United States Marine Corps in the area south of the DMZ in Quang Tri Province. This was another operation to secure the Con Thien area from the North Vietnamese Army (NVA). The operation ran from November 1, 1967 until February 28, 1969.

zh.s: 肯塔基行动是美国海军陆战队在广治省非军事区以南开展的一次多营行动，旨在确保肯天地区不受北越军控制。行动从1967年11月1日持续到1969年2月28日。

en.s: The 1967 Svenska Cupen final took place on 1 November 1967 at Idrottsparken in Norrköping. It was the first final since 1953 and the second consecutive final between Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and IFK Norrköping. IFK Norrköping played their fifth final in total and Malmö FF played their seventh final in total. Malmö FF won their third consecutive final and their sixth title with a 2–0 victory.

zh.s: 1967年瑞典杯决赛于1967年11月1日在北雪平的体育公园举行。这是自1953年以来首次举行决赛，也是连续第二年由瑞典超级联赛球队马尔默和北雪平交锋。北雪平第五次进入决赛，马尔默则是第七次。马尔默以2比0获胜，连续第三次赢得决赛，并第六次夺冠。

en.s: Operation Coronado IX was a riverine military operation conducted by the Mobile Riverine Force (MRF) of the United States and elements of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) from November 1967 to January 1968 in an attempt to destroy Viet Cong (VC) strongholds in the Mekong Delta. In the middle of November, clashes resulted in the capture of VC supplies and hideouts.

en.s: The 1968 United Nations Security Council election was held on 1 November 1968 during the Twenty-third session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The General Assembly elected Colombia, Finland, Nepal, Spain, and Zambia (all but Colombia elected for the first time), as the five new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 1969.

zh.s: 1968年联合国安全理事会选举于1968年11月1日举行，期间正值联合国大会第二十三届会议，会址在纽约的联合国总部。大会选出哥伦比亚、芬兰、尼泊尔、西班牙和赞比亚为安理会五个新任非常任理事国，任期两年，自1969年1月1日起算。除哥伦比亚外，其余四国均为首次当选。

en.s: Operation Toan Thang IV ("Complete Victory") was a U.S. Army and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) operation conducted between 1 November 1969 and 1 May 1970 in the Vietnam War. The operation was designed to keep pressure on Vietcong (VC) and People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) forces in III Corps.

zh.s: 全胜行动IV（Operation Toan Thang IV）是越南战争期间美国陆军和越南共和国陆军（ARVN）实施的一项行动，时间为1969年11月1日至1970年5月1日。行动旨在持续向越共（VC）和越南人民军（PAVN）第三军区部队施压。

en.s: The Club Cinq-Sept fire was a major blaze at a nightclub just outside Saint-Laurent-du-Pont, Isère in south-eastern France on Sunday, 1 November 1970. The catastrophe claimed the lives of 146 people, almost all of whom were aged between 17 and 30. The scale of the disaster shocked the French nation. Subsequent official enquiries revealed a catalogue of shortcomings, oversights and evasions with regard to fire safety at both local and département level. Criminal charges were brought against a number of people; some received suspended jail sentences.

zh.s: 1970年11月1日星期日，法国东南部伊泽尔省圣洛朗迪蓬镇郊外的Cinq-Sept夜总会发生严重火灾，造成146人死亡，死者几乎都在17至30岁之间。这场灾难震惊法国全国。之后的官方调查发现，地方和省级机构在消防安全方面存在一系列疏漏、失察和隐瞒。多人受到刑事起诉，其中一些人被判缓刑。

en.t: Democratic Republic of the Congo presidential election, 1970
en.s: A presidential election was held in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 1 November 1970. The only candidate was Joseph Mobutu, who had taken power in a military coup five years earlier. The election took the format of a "yes" or "no" vote for Mobutu's candidacy, with the results showing he won more "yes" votes than the number of registered voters, even though voting was not compulsory.

zh.t: 1970年刚果民主共和国总统选举
zh.s: 刚果民主共和国于1970年11月1日举行总统选举。唯一候选人是约瑟夫·蒙博托，他在五年前通过军事政变掌权。选民以“赞成”或“反对”的方式对蒙博托的候选资格投票。尽管投票并非强制，公布的“赞成”票数却高于登记选民总数。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1975 were held on November 1, 1975, in Louisiana, and three days later in Kentucky and Mississippi. No governorships changed hands in these elections, as all three southern states remained under Democratic control. This was the first gubernatorial election in Louisiana's history which was conducted under the Nonpartisan blanket primary (AKA Jungle Primary) format.

zh.s: 1975年美国州长选举于11月1日在路易斯安那州举行，三天后肯塔基州和密西西比州也举行选举。三个南方州都由民主党继续执政，没有州长职位易手。这是路易斯安那州历史上首次采用无党派双轮淘汰初选（也称丛林初选）举行州长选举。

en.s: The 1975 Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 1, 1975, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Louisiana. Democratic candidate and incumbent Lieutenant Governor Jimmy Fitzmorris won re-election against fellow Democratic candidates William Bowen and Frederick D. Perkins and Republican nominee Lance A. Britton.

zh.t: 1975年路易斯安那州副州长选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1975年11月1日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、现任副州长吉米·菲茨莫里斯击败同党候选人威廉·鲍恩、弗雷德里克·D·珀金斯，以及共和党候选人兰斯·A·布里顿，成功连任。

en.s: The 1975 Louisiana gubernatorial election resulted in the re-election of Edwin Edwards to his second term as governor of Louisiana. Edwards characterized his victory as a “solid expression of support by the people of Louisiana for some expansive reform.” Edwards's re-election in 1975 to a second consecutive term marked the last time that a Democrat achieved that milestone until 2019, 44 years later, when John Bel Edwards (no relation) won re-election.

zh.s: 1975年路易斯安那州州长选举后，埃德温·爱德华兹再次当选，开始第二个州长任期。爱德华兹称，这场胜利“充分表明路易斯安那州民众支持全面改革”。他在1975年连任，连续第二次赢得州长选举；直到44年后的2019年，约翰·贝尔·爱德华兹（与他无亲属关系）连任，才有另一位民主党人做到这一点。

en.s: The 1976 Burundian coup d'état was a bloodless military coup that took place in Burundi on 1 November 1976. An Army faction, led by Deputy Chief of Staff Jean-Baptiste Bagaza, ousted President Michel Micombero. Bagaza formed the 30-member Supreme Revolutionary Council to take control, suspended the country's constitution and was inaugurated as president on 10 November 1976.

zh.s: 1976年11月1日，布隆迪发生了一场不流血的军事政变。由副总参谋长让-巴蒂斯特·巴加扎领导的一支军队派系推翻了总统米歇尔·米孔贝罗。巴加扎成立由30人组成的最高革命委员会接管政权，暂停宪法，并于1976年11月10日就任总统。

en.s: Operation Seiljag was a South African 32 Battalion search and destroy campaign conducted against the People's Liberation Army of Namibia (PLAN) from November 1976 to March 1977, during the South African Border War. en.s: The Mayoral election of 1977 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 1, 1977. The incumbent mayor, Richard Caliguiri, had ascended to the office just 10 months earlier, after longtime mayor Pete Flaherty resigned to take a position in the newly formed Jimmy Carter White House. The former City Council President chose to renounce his lifelong Democratic Party membership for the election and run for his first full term as an Independent.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡于1977年11月1日星期二举行市长选举。现任市长理查德·卡利吉里上任仅10个月，此前长期担任市长的皮特·弗拉赫蒂辞职，前往新成立的吉米·卡特白宫任职。前市议会主席卡利吉里为竞选自己的首个完整任期，放弃了终身所属的民主党身份，以独立人士身份参选。

en.t: The current Constitution of Antigua and Barbuda was adopted upon independence on 1 November 1981
en.s: Antigua and Barbuda is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean composed of Antigua, Barbuda, and dozens of other small islands. Antigua and Barbuda has a total area of 440 km2 (170 sq mi), making it one of the smallest countries in the Caribbean. The country is mostly flat, with the highest points on Antigua being in the Shekerley Mountains and on Barbuda the Highlands.

zh.t: 安提瓜和巴布达独立后通过现行宪法
zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达是加勒比海的群岛国家，由安提瓜岛、巴布达岛及数十座小岛组成。该国总面积为440平方公里，是加勒比地区面积最小的国家之一。安提瓜岛大部分地势平坦，最高点位于谢克利山脉；巴布达岛的高地则是该岛最高处。

en.s: The Honda Accord (Japanese: ホンダ・アコード, Hepburn: Honda Akōdo; ), also known as the Honda Inspire (Japanese: ホンダ・インスパイア, Hepburn: Honda Insupaia) in Japan and China for certain generations, is a series of automobiles manufactured by Honda since 1976, best known for its four-door sedan variant, which has been one of the best-selling cars in the United States since 1989.
en.n: Honda becomes the first Asian automobile company to produce cars in the United States with the opening of its factory in Marysville, Ohio; a Honda Accord is the first car produced there.

zh.s: 本田雅阁（日文：ホンダ・アコード，罗马字：Honda Akōdo）是一款由本田自1976年起生产的汽车，在日本和中国的部分车型世代中也称本田Inspire（日文：ホンダ・インスパイア，罗马字：Honda Insupaia）。雅阁以四门轿车款最为知名，自1989年以来一直是美国最畅销的车型之一。
zh.n: 本田于1982年11月1日在俄亥俄州马里斯维尔工厂开始生产汽车；下线的第一辆车是本田雅阁。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 1 November 1986 to elect the 89 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. It followed a redistribution which increased the number of seats in the Assembly from 82 to 89. The election resulted in a seventh consecutive term for the National Party under Sir Joh Bjelke-Petersen.

zh.s: 1986年11月1日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州立法议会的89名议员。此前选区调整将议会席位从82个增加到89个。选举后，约翰·比耶尔克-彼得森爵士领导的国家党连续第七次执政。

en.s: The 1990 United Nations Security Council election was held on 1 November 1990 during the Forty-fifth session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The General Assembly elected Austria, Belgium, Ecuador, India, and Zimbabwe, as the five new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 1991.

zh.s: 1990年联合国安全理事会选举于1990年11月1日举行，期间正值联合国大会第四十五届会议，会址在纽约的联合国总部。大会选出奥地利、比利时、厄瓜多尔、印度和津巴布韦为安理会五个新任非常任理事国，任期两年，自1991年1月1日起算。

en.t: President of the Chechen Republic Dzhokhar Dudayev declares sovereignty of the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria from the Russian Federation
en.s: Dzhokhar Musayevich Dudayev (born Dudin Musa-Khant Dzhokhar; 15 February 1944 – 21 April 1996) was a Chechen politician, revolutionary and military leader of the 1990s Chechen independence movement from Russia. He served as the first president of the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria from 1991 until his assassination in 1996. Dudayev had previously served as a senior officer in the Soviet Air Forces.

zh.t: 车臣共和国总统焦哈尔·杜达耶夫宣布伊奇克里亚车臣共和国脱离俄罗斯联邦
zh.s: 焦哈尔·穆萨耶维奇·杜达耶夫（出生名：杜丁·穆萨-坎特·焦哈尔；1944年2月15日—1996年4月21日）是20世纪90年代车臣独立运动中的车臣政治人物、革命者和军事领导人。他于1991年至1996年担任伊奇克里亚车臣共和国首任总统，后遭暗杀。杜达耶夫此前曾是苏联空军高级军官。

en.s: The 1992 Algerian Super Cup is the 2nd edition of Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the Championnat National and 1991–92 Algerian Cup competitions. The first edition was in 1981, leaving a ten year gap. The match was played on 1 November 1992 at Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers. It was between Championnat National winners MC Oran and Algerian Cup winners JS Kabylie.

zh.s: 1992年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第二届赛事，由阿尔及利亚全国锦标赛冠军和1991–92赛季阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。首届赛事于1981年举行，此后相隔十年。本场比赛于1992年11月1日在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行，对阵双方是全国锦标赛冠军奥兰穆鲁迪亚和阿尔及利亚杯冠军卡比利青年体育会。

en.t: October 1992 Turkish attack on Hakurk Camp
en.s: October 1992 Turkish attack on Hakurk Camp (Turkish: Ekim 1992 Hakurk Kampı saldırısı) was a cross-border operation by the Turkish Armed Forces into northern Iraq between 12 October and 1 November 1992, that was conducted during the October 1992 Turkish incursion into Northern Iraq, against the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) which is listed as a terrorist organization internationally by a number of states and organizations, including the United States, NATO and the EU.

zh.t: 1992年10月土耳其袭击哈库尔克营地
zh.s: 1992年10月土耳其袭击哈库尔克营地（土耳其语：Ekim 1992 Hakurk Kampı saldırısı）是土耳其武装部队进入伊拉克北部的一次跨境行动，行动时间为1992年10月12日至11月1日。该行动属于1992年10月土耳其入侵伊拉克北部的一部分，目标是库尔德工人党（PKK）。美国、北约和欧盟等多个国家及组织将该党列为恐怖组织。

en.s: The Halloween Massacre (also known as the Three Day War) was a purge of UNITA party members and supporters carried out by Angola's ruling MPLA from October 30 to November 1, 1992, in Luanda, Angola. The unrest occurred as a result of the breakdown of the Bicesse Accords, on account of alleged voter fraud in the 1992 Angolan general elections, resulting in renewed military tensions, assassinations of public figures, and acts of terrorism.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 万圣节大屠杀也称“三日战争”，是安哥拉执政党争取安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟（UNITA）的成员和支持者遭到清洗的事件，发生于1992年10月30日至11月1日，地点在安哥拉罗安达。比塞斯协议破裂以及1992年安哥拉大选被指存在舞弊，引发了这场动荡，随后军事紧张局势加剧，公众人物遭暗杀，也发生了恐怖袭击。

en.s: The Treaty on European Union, commonly known as the Maastricht Treaty, is the foundation treaty of the European Union (EU). Concluded in 1992 between the then-twelve member states of the European Communities, it announced "a new stage in the process of European integration" chiefly in provisions for a shared European citizenship, for the eventual introduction of a single currency, and (with less precision) for common foreign and security policies, and a number of changes to the European institutions and their decision-making procedures, not least a strengthening of the powers of the European Parliament and more majority voting on the Council of Ministers.
en.n: The Maastricht Treaty takes effect, formally establishing the European Union.

zh.s: 《欧洲联盟条约》通常称为《马斯特里赫特条约》，是欧盟的奠基条约。该条约于1992年由当时欧洲共同体的12个成员国缔结，宣告欧洲一体化“进入一个新阶段”，主要内容包括确立共同的欧洲公民身份、为最终采用单一货币作准备，以及较为原则性地提出共同外交与安全政策；条约还调整了欧盟机构及其决策程序，尤其扩大欧洲议会的权力，并增加部长理事会的多数表决事项。
zh.n: 《马斯特里赫特条约》生效，欧盟正式成立。

en.t: The European Union was formally established when the Maastricht Treaty—whose main architects were Horst Köhler, Helmut Kohl and François Mitterrand—came into force on 1 November 1993
en.s: The European Union (EU) is a political and economic union of 27 member states that are located primarily in Europe. A supranational union with a total area of 4,233,255 km2 (1,634,469 sq mi) and an estimated population of just under 452 million as of 2026, its member states generated a nominal gross domestic product (GDP) of around €18.802 trillion in 2025, accounting for approximately one sixth of global economic output.

zh.t: 《马斯特里赫特条约》生效，欧盟正式成立
zh.s: 《马斯特里赫特条约》于1993年11月1日生效，欧盟由此正式成立。条约的主要设计者包括霍斯特·克勒、赫尔穆特·科尔和弗朗索瓦·密特朗。欧盟是一个政治和经济联盟，现有27个成员国，主要位于欧洲。这个超国家联盟总面积为4,233,255平方公里（1,634,469平方英里），截至2026年人口估计略低于4.52亿。成员国2025年名义国内生产总值约为18.802万亿欧元，约占全球经济产出的六分之一。

en.s: Malakand revolt was a Islamist Jihadist insurrection in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa region by Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi under the command of Sufi Muhammad in Malakand Division on the basis of a demand for Sharia law. Multiple areas were captured by the TNSM militants. The uprising was quashed by the Pakistan government and armed forces resulting in militant-occupied areas being captured and a peace deal being signed.

zh.s: 马拉坎德叛乱是巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省的一场伊斯兰圣战主义叛乱，由苏菲·穆罕默德领导的“伊斯兰教法实施运动”在马拉坎德专区发动，诉求是实施伊斯兰教法。运动武装一度控制多个地区。巴基斯坦政府和军队平息了起义，夺回武装人员控制的地区，并达成和平协议。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in South Africa in 1995 and 1996. Over 11 000 seats were contested of which the African National Congress won 6 032, the National Party 1 814, the Inkhata Freedom Party 754 and the Democratic Party 138. The elections were held on 1 November 1995 in most of the country, but delayed to 29 May 1996 in the Western Cape and 26 June 1996 in KwaZulu-Natal due to boundary demarcation disputes.

zh.s: 南非于1995年和1996年举行市政选举，共有超过1.1万个席位待选。非洲人国民大会赢得6032席，国民党赢得1814席，因卡塔自由党赢得754席，民主党赢得138席。南非大部分地区于1995年11月1日投票；由于选区划分争议，西开普省的选举推迟至1996年5月29日，夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省则推迟至同年6月26日。

en.s: The city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada held municipal elections on November 1, 1998, to elect a mayor and city councillors. Pierre Bourque was returned to a second term as mayor against a divided opposition. Various suburban communities on the Island of Montreal also held elections on November 1.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市于1998年11月1日举行市政选举，选出市长和市议员。皮埃尔·布尔克击败分裂的反对派，再次当选市长。在蒙特利尔岛上的多个郊区社区也于11月1日举行选举。

en.s: November to Remember (1998) was the sixth November to Remember professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on November 1, 1998 from the Lakefront Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. Seven professional wrestling matches were held at the event. The main event was a six-man tag team match, in which the team of Sabu, Rob Van Dam and Taz defeated Triple Threat (Shane Douglas, Bam Bam Bigelow and Chris Candido).

zh.s: 1998年“难忘的十一月”是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第六届同名职业摔角付费电视赛事。赛事于1998年11月1日在路易斯安那州新奥尔良的湖滨竞技场举行，共有7场职业摔角比赛。主赛是六人双打赛，萨布、罗布·范·达姆和塔兹组成的队伍击败了三重威胁组合（沙恩·道格拉斯、班班·比格罗和克里斯·坎迪多）。

en.s: The 1998 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 1998 Norwegian Football Cup, the 93rd season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 1 November 1998 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Tippeligaen sides Stabæk and Rosenborg.

zh.s: 1998年挪威足球杯决赛是该届赛事的决胜场，也是挪威足球杯第93个赛季的最后一场比赛。挪威足球杯是由挪威足球协会（NFF）组织的全国主要杯赛。决赛于1998年11月1日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行，对阵双方是挪威顶级联赛球队斯塔贝克和罗森博格。

en.t: Turkey, Australia, and Canada agree to commit troops to the invasion of Afghanistan
en.s: Shortly after the September 11 attacks in 2001, the United States declared the war on terror and subsequently led a multinational military operation against Taliban-ruled Afghanistan. The stated goal was to dismantle al-Qaeda, which had executed the attacks under the leadership of Osama bin Laden, and to deny al-Qaeda militants a safe base of operations in Afghanistan by toppling the ruling Taliban government.

zh.t: 土耳其、澳大利亚和加拿大同意向阿富汗战争派兵
zh.s: 2001年9月11日袭击事件后不久，美国宣布发动反恐战争，并随后领导多国部队在阿富汗开展军事行动。行动的公开目标是瓦解由奥萨马·本·拉登领导、策划袭击的基地组织，并推翻塔利班政府，阻止基地组织武装人员继续把阿富汗作为安全据点。

en.s: Taiwan Pride (Chinese: 臺灣同志遊行) is the annual LGBTQ pride parade in Taiwan. The parade was first held in 2003. Although joined by groups from all over the country, the primary location has always been the capital city of Taipei. The parade held in October 2019 attracted more than 200,000 participants, making it the largest gay pride event in East Asia.
en.n: The first Taiwan Pride parade was held on November 1, 2003, coinciding with the fourth Taipei Fun Festival (台北同玩節), which had been the first city-sponsored homosexual event in 2000.

zh.s: 台湾同志游行是台湾每年举行的LGBTQ骄傲游行，首届于2003年举办。来自全台各地的团体都会参加，主要举办地点一直是首府台北。2019年10月举行的游行吸引超过20万人参加，是东亚规模最大的同志骄傲活动。
zh.n: 首届台湾同志游行于2003年11月1日举行，与第四届台北同玩节同期举办。2000年的首届台北同玩节是首个由市政府主办的同性恋活动。

en.s: Taboo Tuesday (2005) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on November 1, 2005, at the iPayOne Center in San Diego, California. It was the second annual Taboo Tuesday event in which the fans were given the chance to vote on stipulations for the matches. The voting for the event started on October 24, 2005, and ended during the event. Eight professional wrestling matches were featured on the event's card. The buildup to the matches and the scenarios that took place before, during, and after the event were planned by WWE's script writers.

zh.s: 2005年“禁忌星期二”是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的一场职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2005年11月1日在美国加利福尼亚州圣迭戈的iPayOne中心举行。这是第二届“禁忌星期二”，粉丝可以投票决定比赛规则。赛事投票从2005年10月24日开始，到比赛当天结束。赛事共安排8场职业摔角比赛。WWE编剧团队事先编排了各场比赛的铺垫，以及比赛前、中、后的剧情。

en.s: A regional election was held in Catalonia on 1 November 2006 to elect the 8th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 135 seats in the Parliament were up for election. Unlike other occasions, the election was held on a public holiday during the workweek, All Saints' Day.

zh.s: 2006年11月1日，加泰罗尼亚举行自治区选举，选出该自治区议会第八届议员。议会135个席位全部改选。这次选举与以往不同，安排在工作日的公共假日诸圣节举行。

en.s: The 2006 Algerian Super Cup is the 5th edition of Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the Championnat National and 2005–06 Algerian Cup competitions. The match was played on 1 November 2006 at Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers. Algerian Cup winners MC Alger defeated Championnat National winners JS Kabylie with a score of 2-1.

zh.s: 2006年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第五届赛事，由全国锦标赛冠军和2005–06赛季阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。比赛于2006年11月1日在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行。阿尔及利亚杯冠军阿尔及尔穆鲁迪亚以2比1击败全国锦标赛冠军卡比利青年体育会。

en.s: The 2007 Algerian Super Cup is the 6th edition of Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the Championnat National and 2006–07 Algerian Cup competitions. The match was played on 1 November 2007 at Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers. Algerian Cup winners MC Alger defeated Championnat National winners ES Sétif with a score of 4-0.

zh.s: 2007年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第六届赛事，由全国锦标赛冠军和2006–07赛季阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。比赛于2007年11月1日在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行。阿尔及利亚杯冠军阿尔及尔穆鲁迪亚以4比0击败全国锦标赛冠军塞蒂夫青年体育会。

en.s: World Victory Road Presents: Sengoku 6 was a mixed martial arts-event promoted by World Victory Road. The event took place on November 1, 2008 at the Saitama Super Arena in Saitama City, Japan. It featured the semi-final and final matches of the organization's Lightweight- and Middleweight Grand Prix tournaments, allowing each tournament winner the opportunity to fight for the promotions championship.

zh.s: World Victory Road Presents：战国6是由World Victory Road推广的综合格斗赛事，于2008年11月1日在日本埼玉市埼玉超级竞技场举行。赛事包含联盟轻量级和中量级大奖赛的半决赛与决赛，两项赛事的冠军都将获得争夺联盟冠军头衔的机会。

en.s: 2008 J.League Cup final was the 16th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 1, 2008. Oita Trinita won the championship.

zh.s: 2008年日本联赛杯决赛是该项赛事第16届决赛，于2008年11月1日在东京国立霞丘陆上竞技场举行。大分三神队赢得冠军。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2010) was a professional wrestling event, the fifth annual El Castillo del Terror event, produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG). IWRG has held an Castillo del Terror branded show since 2005, usually late in the year, making this year's event the fifth overall event in the series. The event took place on November 1, 2009, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, IWRG's main arena. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Castle of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated was forced to unmasked per the match stipulation.

en.s: The 2009 Boucherville municipal election was an election that was held on the 1st of November 2009 to elect Boucherville's mayor and eight councillors. Jean Martel and his party's eight candidates were elected. The voter turnout was 49.8%. The election results were made available on the website of Québec's Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing.

en.s: The 2011 Miami Beach mayoral election, a nonpartisan race, was held on Tuesday, November 1, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Matti Herrera Bower, who was first elected in 2007, won a third and final two-year term. She was challenged by three opponents.

zh.s: 2011年迈阿密海滩市长选举于11月1日星期二举行，选举不按党派划分。现任市长马蒂·埃雷拉·鲍尔于2007年首次当选，此次连任，开始她最后一个两年任期。她有三名对手。

en.s: Operation Mobile (French: Opération Mobile) was the name given to Canadian Forces activities in the 2011 military intervention in Libya. The United States' counterpart to this was Operation Odyssey Dawn, the French counterpart was Opération Harmattan and the British counterpart was Operation Ellamy. The no-fly zone was proposed during the Libyan Civil War to prevent government forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi from carrying out air attacks on anti-Gaddafi forces and civilians.

en.s: Following the end of the First Libyan Civil War, which overthrew Muammar Gaddafi, there was violence involving various militias and the new state security forces. This violence escalated into the Second Libyan Civil War (2014–2020). The militias included guerrillas, Islamists, and militias who fought against Gaddafi but refused to lay down their arms when the war ended in October 2011.

en.s: The 2011 Hialeah mayoral special election took place on November 15, 2011, following a first round on November 1, 2011. Former Mayor Julio Robaina resigned so that he could run for Mayor of Miami-Dade County. Following Robaina's resignation, City Council President Carlos Hernández became Mayor. Hernández ran in the special election to serve out the remaining two years of Robaina's term.

zh.s: 海厄利亚于2011年11月15日举行市长特别选举，此前已于11月1日举行第一轮投票。前市长胡利奥·罗拜纳辞职，以竞选迈阿密-戴德县县长。罗拜纳辞职后，市议会主席卡洛斯·埃尔南德斯接任市长，并参加特别选举，争取完成罗拜纳剩余的两年任期。

en.s: The 2014 Malaysia Cup final was a football match which was played on 1 November 2014, to determine the winners of the 2014 Malaysia Cup. It was the final of the 88th edition of the Malaysia Cup, competition organised by the Football Association of Malaysia. The final was played between Johor Darul Takzim and Pahang.

zh.s: 2014年马来西亚杯决赛于11月1日举行，决出该届马来西亚杯冠军。这是第88届马来西亚杯的决赛，赛事由马来西亚足球协会主办。决赛由柔佛达鲁塔克欣对阵彭亨。

en.s: The Battle of Al-Shaykh Maskin (Arabic: معركة الشيخ مسكين الأولى) was a military engagement during the Syrian civil war in the Daraa Governorate, where Syrian government forces attempted to capture Al-Shaykh Maskin to secure the Daraa–Damascus highway. Two days later, rebel forces launched two joint offensives, code-named "Edkholo Alayhem al-Bab" (Enter upon them through the gate) and "Hadm al-Jedar" (Demolition Of The Wall), to take control of Al-Shaykh Maskin and the nearby town of Nawa.

zh.s: 谢赫马斯金战役是叙利亚内战期间发生在德拉省的一场军事交战。叙利亚政府军试图攻占谢赫马斯金，以确保德拉至大马士革公路的安全。两天后，反政府武装发动两场联合攻势，代号分别为“从门口攻入”和“拆除围墙”，以夺取谢赫马斯金及附近的纳瓦镇。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2015) (Spanish for "The Tower of Terror") was a major professional wrestling event, the eleventh annual El Castillo del Terror event, produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) that took place on November 1, 2015. IWRG has held their Castillo del Terror show since 2005, usually late in the year. As with the majority of the IWRG shows it took place at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, the home of IWRG. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror Steel cage match where the last person eliminated would be forced to unmasked per the match stipulation.

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 1 November 2015 to elect 550 members to the Grand National Assembly. They were the 25th general elections in the history of the Republic of Turkey and elected the country's 26th Parliament. The election resulted in the Justice and Development Party (AKP) regaining a parliamentary majority following a 'shock' victory, having lost it five months earlier in the June 2015 general elections.

zh.s: 2015年11月1日，土耳其举行大选，选出大国民议会的550名议员。这是土耳其共和国历史上的第25次大选，选出该国第26届议会。正义与发展党（AKP）意外获胜，重新取得议会多数席位；该党五个月前在2015年6月大选中失去了多数席位。

en.s: The 2015 Algerian Super Cup was the 9th edition of Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the 2014–15 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 and 2014–15 Algerian Cup competitions. The match was played on November 1, 2015 at Chahid Hamlaoui Stadium in Constantine. Ligue 1 winners ES Sétif won the match 1–0 against Algerian Cup winners MO Béjaïa.

zh.s: 2015年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第九届赛事，由2014–15赛季阿尔及利亚职业足球甲级联赛冠军和阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。比赛于2015年11月1日在君士坦丁的沙希德·哈姆拉维体育场举行。甲级联赛冠军塞蒂夫青年体育会以1比0击败阿尔及利亚杯冠军贝贾亚穆鲁迪亚。

en.s: The 2015 FA WSL Cup final was the fifth final of the FA WSL Cup, England's secondary cup competition for women's football teams and its primary league cup tournament. Arsenal beat Notts County 3-0.

zh.t: 2015年英格兰女子足球超级联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 2015年英格兰女子足球超级联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第五场决赛。该杯赛是英格兰女子足球的次级杯赛，也是主要的联赛杯赛事。阿森纳以3比0击败诺茨郡。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 1 November 2016 to elect a President and the National Congress. Incumbent President Tommy Remengesau was challenged by his brother-in-law, Surangel Whipps Jr. for the presidency, emerging as the top two in the primary elections on 27 September. Remengesau was subsequently re-elected with 51% of the vote.

zh.s: 帕劳于2016年11月1日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。现任总统汤米·雷门格绍的挑战者是其妹夫苏兰格尔·惠普斯二世。两人在9月27日的初选中排名前两位。雷门格绍随后以51%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2016 Algerian Super Cup was the 10th edition of Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the 2015–16 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 and 2015–16 Algerian Cup competitions. The match was played on November 1, 2016, at Mustapha Tchaker Stadium in Blida. Ligue 1 winners USM Alger defeated Algerian Cup winners MC Alger with a score of 2-0.

zh.s: 2016年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第十届赛事，由2015–16赛季阿尔及利亚职业足球甲级联赛冠军和阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。比赛于2016年11月1日在布利达的穆斯塔法·查克尔体育场举行。甲级联赛冠军阿尔及尔联合体育会以2比0击败阿尔及利亚杯冠军阿尔及尔穆鲁迪亚。

en.s: The 2017 Algerian Super Cup was the 11th edition of the Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the 2016–17 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 and 2016–17 Algerian Cup competitions. It is known as the Mobilis Supercoupe d'Algérie 2017 due to the start of a sponsorship deal with Mobilis ATM. The match was played on November 1, 2017, at Chahid Hamlaoui Stadium in Constantine.

zh.s: 2017年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第11届赛事，由2016–17赛季阿尔及利亚职业足球甲级联赛冠军和阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。由于与Mobilis ATM开始赞助合作，赛事也称Mobilis Supercoupe d'Algérie 2017。比赛于2017年11月1日在君士坦丁的沙希德·哈姆拉维体育场举行。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2018) (Spanish for "The Tower of Terror") was a major professional wrestling event, the eleventh annual El Castillo del Terror event, scripted and produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) that took place on November 1, 2018. IWRG has held their Castillo del Terror show since 2005, usually late in the year.

zh.s: 2018年“恐怖城堡”（西班牙语：El Castillo del Terror，意为“恐怖之塔”）是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）策划并制作的一场大型职业摔角赛事，也是该系列第11届年度活动，于2018年11月1日举行。IWRG自2005年起通常在年底举办“恐怖城堡”赛事。

en.s: The 2018 Algerian Super Cup was the 12th edition of the Algerian Super Cup, a football match contested by the winners of the 2017–18 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 and 2017–18 Algerian Cup competitions. It is known as the Mobilis Supercoupe d'Algérie 2018 due to a sponsorship deal with Mobilis ATM. The match was played on November 1, 2018 at Mustapha Tchaker Stadium in Blida.

zh.s: 2018年阿尔及利亚超级杯是第12届赛事，由2017–18赛季阿尔及利亚职业足球甲级联赛冠军和阿尔及利亚杯冠军争夺。由于Mobilis ATM赞助，赛事也称Mobilis Supercoupe d'Algérie 2018。比赛于2018年11月1日在布利达的穆斯塔法·查克尔体育场举行。

en.s: The Crash VIII Aniversario, also known as The Crash Octavio Aniversario (Spanish for The Crash 8th Anniversary Show), was a professional wrestling supercard event, scripted and produced by the Mexican lucha libre promotion The Crash Lucha Libre, which took place on November 1, 2019 at Auditorio Fausto Gutierrez in The Crash's home town of Tijuana, Baja California.

zh.s: The Crash八周年纪念赛也称The Crash Octavio Aniversario（西班牙语意为“The Crash八周年纪念秀”），是一场职业摔角大型赛事，由墨西哥摔角推广组织The Crash Lucha Libre策划并制作。赛事于2019年11月1日在下加利福尼亚州蒂华纳的福斯托·古铁雷斯礼堂举行，蒂华纳也是The Crash的大本营。

en.s: The 2019 CMLL Día de Muertos was a lineup of two professional wrestling supercard events, scripted and produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). The shows were held on November 1 and November 3, 2019, at Arena México, in Mexico City, Mexico, as the CMLL’s sixth annual celebration of the Mexican Day of the Dead.

zh.s: 2019年CMLL亡灵节赛事由两场职业摔角大型赛事组成，由墨西哥摔角推广组织墨西哥摔角委员会（CMLL）策划并制作。两场比赛于2019年11月1日和3日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，是CMLL第六次举办亡灵节年度庆祝赛事。

en.s: The 2020 Women's FA Cup final (known as the Vitality Women's FA Cup Final for sponsorship reasons was the 50th final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 27th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA). The final, contested between Everton and Manchester City, was played on Sunday 1 November 2020 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2020年英格兰女子足总杯决赛因赞助冠名而称为“Vitality女子足总杯决赛”，是女子足总杯第50届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛决赛。这是英格兰足球总会直接监管的第27届决赛。埃弗顿队与曼彻斯特城队于2020年11月1日星期日在伦敦温布利球场争夺冠军。

en.s: The 2020 Bellatorum Resources Pro Classic was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts. It was the fourth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2020 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Tyler, Texas, United States between 26 October and 1 November 2020.

zh.t: 2020年贝拉托鲁姆资源职业挑战赛
zh.s: 2020年贝拉托鲁姆资源职业挑战赛是一项职业网球赛事，在室外硬地球场举行。这是该赛事第4届，属于2020年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛，于2020年10月26日至11月1日在美国得克萨斯州泰勒举行。

en.s: The Democratic Alliance (DA) held its leadership conference virtually between 31 October and 1 November 2020. It was originally scheduled to be held in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 outbreak. The previous congress was held in 2018. In October 2019, then-party leader Mmusi Maimane announced that the party would seek to hold a policy conference and early elective congress in 2020.

zh.s: 民主联盟（DA）于2020年10月31日至11月1日在线举行领导层会议。会议原定于2020年5月举行，后因COVID-19疫情推迟。上一次代表大会于2018年举行。2019年10月，时任党领袖穆穆西·马伊马内宣布，该党计划在2020年举行政策会议和提前举行的选举代表大会。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Moldova on 1 November. The fourth direct elections since independence in 1991, voters had the possibility to either elect a new president or re-elect the incumbent Igor Dodon. Because no candidate received a majority of votes in the first round, a run-off between the top two candidates, Maia Sandu and Dodon, was held on 15 November.

zh.s: 摩尔多瓦于2020年11月1日举行总统选举。这是该国1991年独立后第四次直接选举，选民可选择新总统或让现任总统伊戈尔·多东连任。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人玛雅·桑杜和多东于11月15日参加第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2021 South African Municipal Elections were held on 1 November 2021, to elect councils for all district, metropolitan and local municipalities in each of the country's nine provinces. It was the 6th municipal election cycle held in South Africa since the end of apartheid in 1994, with the previous municipal elections having been held in 2016.

zh.s: 2021年11月1日，南非举行市镇选举，改选该国九个省份所有区级、大都市和地方市镇的议会。这是南非自1994年种族隔离制度结束以来的第六轮市镇选举，上一次市镇选举于2016年举行。

en.s: The November Chuvash Rebellion or Rebellion Of The Mobilized Chuvashs was a mutiny of ethnic Chuvashs during the Russo-Ukrainian War. It happened on 1 November 2022 when about 100 mobilized Chuvash men refused to go to war and staged an action of disobedience at the training center.

zh.s: 楚瓦什人十一月起义，也称动员兵楚瓦什人叛乱，是俄乌战争期间楚瓦什族人发动的一次哗变。2022年11月1日，约100名被动员的楚瓦什男子拒绝参战，并在训练中心采取抗命行动。

en.s: The 36th Tokyo International Film Festival is film festival that took place from October 23 to November 1, 2023. German filmmaker Wim Wenders served as jury president. en.s: The 2024 Buhodle clashes took place between October 31 and November 1, 2024, in Buhodle district, near the town of Qorilugud, located in the Togdheer region of Somaliland. The conflict involved forces from Somaliland, primarily the affiliated SSB civil militia, and the SSC-Khaatumo movement. The clashes occurred days before Somaliland's scheduled national elections on November 13. The initiation of hostilities remains disputed, with both sides accusing each other of instigating the clash.

en.s: Novi Sad railway station (Serbian: Железничка станица Нови Сад, Železnička stanica Novi Sad) is the main railroad station in Novi Sad, Serbia. The current station, located at Jaše Tomića Boulevard, was opened in 1964, after closing the old railway station from 1883 previously located at what is today the Liman fresh market. The station serves several high-speed trains to Belgrade per day and is part of the Budapest–Belgrade railway project.
